Toast Credit Card Deposit Discrepancies — Update

Toast has fixed the dollar-level variance issue; the cent-level rounding issue is still on track for an end-of-August fix



Following up on our previous announcement about Credit Card Deposit discrepancies, Toast has shared an update covering two separate issues.

Dollar-Level Variances — Fixed
Toast identified a separate bug — unrelated to the rounding issue reported previously — that caused the dollar variances some merchants saw between the Toast Orders API and the Toast Payout report. The issue was in how the Orders API displayed data; the actual payout amounts were accurate throughout. Toast fixed this in early August 2026, so you should no longer see these dollar-level variances going forward.

Cent-Level Rounding — Still In Progress
The smaller, cent-level rounding discrepancies described in our previous announcement are a separate, known issue. Toast is still targeting an official fix by the end of August 2026 and will confirm exact timing once available.

If you notice any new dollar-level variances after early August 2026, please let us know so we can report it back to Toast.

Thank you for your patience. We'll share another update once Toast confirms the rounding fix timeline.

QuickBooks
Windows 7, 8+, 10
Cohesion Connect for QuickBooks Desktop  Downloads

Download and install Cohesion.Connect to the workstation or server where you have QuickBooks installed. This application will act as the bridge between Cohesion and your copy of QuickBooks.


NOTE - You will only need to install Cohesion Connect once for all the companies that you are connecting to Cohesion. So if you have already installed Cohesion.Connect for a different Company, you can skip downloading again.
Dynamics NAV
Windows 7, 8+, 10
Cohesion Connect for Microsoft Dynamics NAV  Downloads

Download and install Cohesion Connect to the workstation where you have a NAV client installed. This application will act as the bridge between Cohesion and your copy of NAV.


NOTE - You can install Cohesion connect on as many Auditor's workstations as you wish. You should add a User for each Auditor that will use Cohesion.
Sage 300 C&RE
Windows 7, 8+, 10
Cohesion Connect for Sage 300 C&RE (Timberline)  Downloads

Download and install Cohesion Connect to the workstation where you have a Sage 300 client installed. This application will act as the bridge between Cohesion and your copy of Sage 300.


NOTE - You can install Cohesion connect on as many Auditor's workstations as you wish. You should add a User for each Auditor that will use Cohesion.
POSitouch
Windows 7, 8+, 10
Cohesion Connect for POSitouch POS  Downloads

Download and install Cohesion Connect to a Site's (Restaurant) Backoffice Workstation. This application will act as the bridge between Cohesion and POSitouch.

Adding New Workflows
  Open In New Tab
  Print

Follow the Steps below to add a new Workflow to Cohesion - they'll walk you through everything you need to select and gather, without affecting any Workflow you're already using.

Step 1 · Select what integration you want to implement with Cohesion.
1. WORKFLOW
Choose a Workflow…
Sales Reconcilation & Journal
Payroll/Time Entries
Payroll Journal
Vendor Purchases
Inventory Transfers
Purchase Transactions

Not sure what these terms mean?

Workflow is what you want to send - your daily Sales, Time Entries (hours worked), or a Payroll Journal.
Source is the point-of-sale (POS) system you use in your restaurant, like Toast or Qu.
Target is the accounting or payroll software you want that information sent to, like QuickBooks or ADP.
